title: 第19章 黑雾之人第20章 史无前例三命轮
content_zh:
客厅中，看着陆安询问的眼神，付雨轻吸一口气，轻轻开了口。
“下午你昏迷的时候，我在学院里转了转，发现这所谓的学院，其实也有不少赚钱的地方。”付雨声音轻冷悦耳，说道，“比如兵器铺、猎手联盟和炼丹阁，加入的话还是能赚到不少钱。”
“宝器铺？猎手联盟？炼丹阁？”陆安有些迷茫，问道，“都是什么？”
“宝器铺，就是制作兵器的地方。天师用的兵器和普通的兵器不一样，天师的兵器大多都不是刀枪棍棒，而是各种能提升自己实力的宝器。想铸造宝器并不简单，不仅需要努力，也需要很大天赋。”
“猎手联盟，就是专门猎杀奇兽的组织。奇兽虽然有一些能为人类所用，但大部分都不会臣服于人类。猎杀奇兽，取其晶核，晶核能用来制造丹药或者镶嵌在宝器上，等级越高的奇兽晶核自然就越值钱。”
“炼丹阁，自然就是炼丹的地方。炼制丹药都要以奇兽晶核为主，辅以各种珍贵药材。和制造宝器一样，炼丹也需要一定天赋，所以说……”
只见付雨美目如水，淡淡看着陆安，说道，“如果你什么天赋都没有的话，我建议你去猎手联盟。”
“猎杀奇兽么……”陆安低头陷入沉思，很快便想到当日追杀父母的那头雪狼，忍不住深吸一口气，点头说道，“好，那我就去参加猎手联盟！”
付雨轻轻点头，说道，“猎手联盟谁都可以做，所以队伍也多。但因为是猎杀奇兽，所以和其他两个组织比起来，多了许多危险性。而且你现在连初等天者都算不上，还是老老实实在学院里学习半年再说吧。”
“可是……”陆安微微皱眉，他知道猎杀一定会有危险，还是说道，“我会小心一点。”
付雨柳眉微锁，她知道陆安没钱，不得不去。若陆安对她开口的话，她还能给他一点，但陆安却根本不开口，她也不会主动。
突然间，付雨眼神微变，仿佛想到了什么，身体前倾，看着陆安问道，“今天，你在淬体之地的表现很出色。”
陆安一愣，没想到付雨会突然说起这个，挠挠头笑着说道，“还好。”
“我的长辈对我说过，意志是有极限的，但一个人的表现如果超出了极限，那就代表他拥有一个绝对的目标，肯为这个目标付出一切。”付雨目光清澈，清醒说道，“那么，你的目标是什么，我很好奇。”
陆安又是一愣，看着一脸质疑的付雨，渐渐平静下来。
我的目标么……
陆安微微低头，头发挡住了他的眼睛，让人无法看见他的眼神。他也不知道自己今天的执拗到底是为了什么，他也想不通，那是一种感觉，是一种不甘心的感觉。
不甘心为奴，不甘心自己的命运和尊严被别人肆意践踏。
“为了改变命运。”陆安抬头，与付雨的眼睛四目相对，说道，“为了让我能安心的活着。”
“……”

付雨看着陆安平静而又坚定的眼神，心中不知怎的，渐渐浮起一点涟漪。就在刚刚波动的时候，她却一下子站了起来，吓了陆安一跳。
“睡吧。”付雨起身，看也不看陆安一眼，转身走向自己的房间。
砰。
看着付雨关门，宿舍中再次安静下来。陆安有些摸不着头脑看着房门，不知道这个女生怎么说翻脸就翻脸。收拾好桌子后，也只能回到自己的房间中。
躺在床上，双手放在脑袋下枕着，陆安看着天花板，脑袋里也不知道在想什么事。
想想来到星火城的这两天，自己经历的一切都是以前无法想象的。奴隶的命运是被人驱使，被人规定好的。但那根本不是生活，现在这才是。
虽然昏睡了一下午，但陆安身体和意识依然虚弱，很快便躺在床上睡着了。
睡梦，是一种无尽的深渊。
content_en:
In the living room, seeing Lu An's questioning eyes, Fu Yu took a breath and spoke softly.
"When you were unconscious in the afternoon, I walked around the academy and found that there are actually many places to make money in this so-called academy." Fu Yu said in a soft, cold voice, "For example, the weapons shop, hunter alliance and alchemy pavilion. If you join, you can still make a lot of money."
"Treasure shop? Hunters' Alliance? Alchemy Pavilion?" Lu An was a little confused and asked, "What are they?"
"The treasure shop is a place where weapons are made. The weapons used by the Celestial Master are different from ordinary weapons. Most of the weapons used by the Celestial Master are not swords, guns and sticks, but various treasures that can enhance one's strength. It is not easy to make treasures. It requires not only hard work, but also a lot of talent."
"The Hunter Alliance is an organization that specializes in hunting strange beasts. Although some strange beasts can be used by humans, most of them will not surrender to humans. After hunting strange beasts, the crystal nuclei can be obtained. The crystal nuclei can be used to make elixirs or be embedded in treasures. The higher the level of the strange beast crystal cores, the more valuable they will naturally be."
"The Alchemy Pavilion is naturally a place for alchemy. Refining elixirs must mainly use the crystal nuclei of strange beasts, supplemented by various precious medicinal materials. Just like making treasures, alchemy also requires a certain amount of talent, so..."
Fu Yu, with beautiful eyes like water, looked at Lu An calmly and said, "If you don't have any talent, I suggest you join the Hunter League."
"Hunting strange beasts..." Lu An lowered his head and fell into deep thought. He soon thought of the snow wolf that chased his parents that day. He couldn't help but take a deep breath, nodded and said, "Okay, then I will join the Hunter League!"
Fu Yu nodded lightly and said, "Anyone in the Hunter Alliance can do it, so there are many teams. But because it is hunting strange beasts, it is much more dangerous than the other two organizations. And you are not even a junior celestial being now, so you should just study in the academy for half a year."
"But..." Lu An frowned slightly. He knew that hunting would be dangerous, but he still said, "I will be more careful."
Fu Yuliu frowned slightly. She knew that Lu An had no money and had to go. If Lu An spoke to her, she could still give him a little, but Lu An didn't speak at all, and she wouldn't take the initiative.
Suddenly, Fu Yu's eyes changed slightly, as if he thought of something. He leaned forward, looked at Lu An and asked, "Today, you performed very well in the Body Tempering Land."
Lu An was stunned, not expecting Fu Yu to suddenly talk about this. He scratched his head and said with a smile, "It's okay."
"My elders told me that there is a limit to will, but if a person's performance exceeds the limit, it means that he has an absolute goal and is willing to sacrifice everything for this goal." Fu Yu said with clear eyes, "So, what is your goal, I am very curious."
Lu An was stunned again, looking at Fu Yu who looked questioning, and gradually calmed down.
Is it my goal...
Lu An lowered his head slightly, his hair blocking his eyes so that no one could see his eyes. He didn't know the reason for his stubbornness today, and he couldn't figure it out. It was a feeling, a feeling of unwillingness.
Not willing to be a slave, not willing to have your destiny and dignity trampled on by others.
"In order to change my destiny." Lu An raised his head, met Fu Yu's eyes and said, "In order for me to live with peace of mind."
"..."
Fu Yu looked at Lu An's calm and firm eyes, and for some reason, a little ripples gradually appeared in his heart. Just when she was fluctuating, she suddenly stood up, startling Lu An.
"Go to sleep." Fu Yu stood up and turned to his room without even looking at Lu An.
Bang.
Watching Fu Yu close the door, the dormitory became quiet again. Lu An looked at the door with some confusion, wondering how this girl could fall out so easily. After clearing the table, he could only go back to his room.
lie downOn the bed, with his hands under his head, Lu An looked at the ceiling, not knowing what was going on in his head.
Thinking about the two days since arriving in Spark City, everything I experienced was unimaginable before. The fate of slaves is driven and determined by others. But that wasn't life at all, this is now.
Although he fell asleep all afternoon, Lu An's body and consciousness were still weak, and he soon fell asleep in bed.
Sleep is an endless abyss.
